heading: Safety check
locked: As long as an error is open, “Apply” stays locked. That is intentional: these are exactly the configurations that break the server.
none: No findings — this draft can be applied safely.
why.BASE_MAP_MISSING: Without the base map the vanilla references of the mod maps do not resolve.
why.BASE_MAP_NOT_LAST: The base map must be loaded last, otherwise it covers the mod maps.
why.BUILD41_ONLY: Build 41 mods do not run on Build 42 — the files are there, but they do not fit.
why.MAP_CELL_CONFLICT: Two maps cannot occupy the same place. The one loaded later overwrites the other — that produces half buildings and crashes.
why.MAP_WITHOUT_PROVIDER: At start the server looks for tiles that do not exist. This is exactly the case that makes the server die when a player joins.
why.MISSING_DEPENDENCY: If a required mod is missing, the start aborts.
why.ORPHAN_MAP_DOWNLOAD: Project Zomboid loads downloaded maps automatically — even ones that are not enabled. That is why the download is moved into quarantine when applying.
why.WORKSHOP_DIR_UNREADABLE: Without a view into the mod directory nothing can be checked. Deliberately nothing is applied, instead of starting on a hunch.
why.WORLD_MAP_REMOVED: The world has already saved terrain for this map. When applying, these areas are moved into quarantine and generated anew — the rest of the world stays untouched.
worldReset_one: When applying, {{count}} world file of the maps that are dropped is moved into quarantine — reversible, the rest of the world is kept.
worldReset_other: When applying, {{count}} world files of the maps that are dropped are moved into quarantine — reversible, the rest of the world is kept.
